title: Read and check capture bytes
responsibility: Reads a recorded capture through the desktop connection and independently checks its hash.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.bridge
inputs.description: The connection the capture is read through; only its optional `artifact` reader is used, and it is called with the query as its only argument. A connection without `artifact` is refused before anything is read, with the `unreadArtifact` message.

inputs.name: artifactBytes.query
inputs.description: The exact capture request, including its binding and expected SHA-256 hash, passed to the reader unchanged. Its `sha256` is the only value the returned bytes are checked against, so they must hash to it whatever the answer claims.

outputs.name: unreadArtifact
outputs.description: The fixed text of the Error thrown when the bridge has no `artifact` reader; it is the same string on every call and is exported from the utils module next to `damagedArtifact`.
examples: Recorded bytes cannot be read on this connection.

outputs.name: damagedArtifact
outputs.description: The fixed text of the Error thrown when the bytes the reader returned do not hash to `query.sha256`, the same string on every call. When it is thrown, no bytes are returned, so a caller never receives bytes that were not checked.
examples: The bytes that were read do not have the recorded SHA-256.

outputs.name: artifactBytes
outputs.description: A promise that resolves to a copy of the reader's bytes, the reader's media type as given, and the SHA-256 computed here from those bytes, which on success equals `query.sha256`. It rejects when the bytes do not hash to `query.sha256`, and any hash the answer claims is ignored.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error the async function throws, so the promise rejects: with the `unreadArtifact` message when the bridge has no `artifact` reader, or with the `damagedArtifact` message when the bytes do not hash to `query.sha256`. Errors from the reader, from reading the answer's bytes, and from the SHA-256 digest are not caught and reject the promise unchanged.
